Author: Arvind Srivastava Bench: Arvind Srivastava  IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA  CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS No.52317 of 2022  Arising Out of PS. Case No.-603 Year-2021 Thana- DAUDNAGAR District- A  ======================================================
 ASHUTOSH KUMAR Son of Suresh Singh Resident of Village - simrabagh,
 P.S.- Daudnagar, District - Aurangabad.
 ... ... 
 Versus  The State of Bihar  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Suraj Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Dilip Kumar No. 1  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 4 23-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT PATNA
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Daudnagar P.S. Case No. 603 of 2021 registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case due to oblique motive.
The matter relates to love affairs.
Further he submits that from perusal of Annexure-2 series, it is evident that the informant and the petitioner performed their marriage in a temple and have been living as husband and wife.
Further he submits that petitioner has no criminal antecedent.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52317 of 2022(4) dt.23-03-2023 case, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of the A.C.J.M., Daudnagar, Aurangabad in connection with Daudnagar P.S. Case No. 603 of 2021, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr. P.C. (Arvind Srivastava, J) shailendra/-
